pages.title: Arcane Materials
pages.text: Arcane ingots and gems lead toward the Arcane Prism and Angelsteel. See $(l:aura:angelsteel_tools)Angelsteel Tools$(/l) and $(l:aura:angelsteel_swords)Angelsteel Swords$(/l) for all tiered craft patterns.

pages.title: Prismatic Wand
pages.text: Open $(l:aura:prismatic_wand)Prismatic Wand$(/l) for selection, copying, placement, limits, and costs.

pages.title: Fury's Rhythm
pages.text: Land hits five to ninety-nine ticks apart to keep a fury chain. Each link compounds the next strike's force by five percent, up to one hundred links. Strike sooner or leave a longer pause, and the chain begins again.

pages.title: A Dropped Red Hole
pages.text: When dropped, the Red Hole explodes about every five seconds and fades after roughly twenty-five minutes of world time. Retrieve it first if you do not want a recurring blast left nearby.

pages.title: Mirror of the Angel
pages.text: Use the Mirror near a fireball or strike one with it. A nearby Ghast- or Blaze-fired fireball guides the deflection; Wither Skulls are not redirected.

pages.title: Transmuting Sword
pages.text: A living hit target changes within these pairs: Cow/Mooshroom, Creeper/Enderman, Sheep/Pig, Ghast/Blaze, Slime/Magma Cube, and Ocelot/Wolf. A transformed creature keeps its name and current health.

pages.title: Thief Sword
pages.text: Hold the sword when a Villager dies for a one-in-four chance to take the first item from its trade offers.

pages.title: Black Hole
pages.text: Keep the Black Hole in your inventory; every five seconds it consumes carried Cobblestone. Store building supplies before carrying it.
